title: Log: add gate return value to FIPS rejection log in ioctl_init
description: fd.c:756-764: ret = ops->fips_gate() is captured but the pr_err at line 759 does not include ret in its format string, then ret is overwritten with -EACCES. The wolfCrypt numeric FIPS status (FIPS_DEGRADED_E vs FIPS_FAILED_E) is lost at the framework level. Fix: add %d for the original gate return value to the pr_err format before the ret = -EACCES overwrite. One-line change to the format string.
